title: CascadeSpan/1.0
description: CANONICAL enforcement-span contract. The single non-negotiable shape binding the enforcement homes named in _dev/concepts/sovereign-core-harness.md (Claude-Code hook today; forked pi-mono native later; Tool Broker for brokered/external-model action). Every home emits THIS shape with identical node/work lineage so the control plane never bifurcates (the council's #1 ranked risk: 'schema bifurcation under urgency'). OWNERSHIP: master-program-of-work Phase-1 is the canonical owner of the cascade identity/lineage discipline, whose emergent implementation is tools/telemetry/dispatches/lib/emit-span.cjs (span_schema_version 3) + tools/telemetry/dispatches/lib/trace-context.cjs. This contract CONSUMES those identity fields (trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, scope lineage) with the owner's field names/semantics and ADDS the enforcement superstructure {node, action, enforcement_home, status}; it does not re-author or fork the identity schema. Each field notes the live owner/concept field it is grounded in.

schema_id.description: Contract identity. Constant for CascadeSpan/1.0 (concept: 'CascadeSpan/1.0 is the single non-negotiable contract').

schema_version.description: Contract version. Mirrors the monotonic span_schema_version pattern live in emit-span.cjs (SPAN_SCHEMA_VERSION).

span_id.description: This action's span identity. Owner field: emit-span.cjs / trace-context.cjs span_id. Any stable non-empty id (UUID-shaped in practice).

parent_span_id.description: Lineage edge to the parent span. Owner field: emit-span.cjs / trace-context.cjs parent_span_id. null at a trace root.

trace_id.description: Cascade/correlation id shared across the whole action tree. Owner field: emit-span.cjs trace_id (=== correlation_id, physical-equivalence contract in trace-context.cjs). null tolerated but SHOULD be set to the cascade root.

node.description: Node/actor identity. Concept names exactly these three sub-fields: {actor, harness, model_family}. Grounded in emit-span.cjs {actor_role, harness, model/model_tier/mind_class}.

actor.description: The role/identity acting (e.g. coordinator, worker, reviewer, broker-adapter). Owner field: emit-span.cjs actor_role.

harness.description: The runtime the action ran under (e.g. claude-code-cli, pi-mono, tool-broker). Owner field: emit-span.cjs harness.

model_family.description: The mind family (e.g. claude, gemini, gpt, local-qwen). Grounded in emit-span.cjs model/model_tier/mind_class. null when no model took the action (pure mechanical hook/sweep).

scope.description: Work/scope lineage. Concept requires 'identical node/work lineage' across homes. Sub-fields consume the owner's live scope/lineage fields in emit-span.cjs / trace-context.cjs.

scope_identity.description: Stable scope id the action belongs to. Owner field: emit-span.cjs / trace-context.cjs scope_identity (env MYTHOS_WORKSTREAM_SCOPE).

work_unit.description: The bounded question/work-unit id (plan id, signal id, step id). Owner field: emit-span.cjs / trace-context.cjs step_id (env MYTHOS_STEP_ID), named work_unit at the enforcement layer.

lineage_root.description: Root of the cascade lineage. Owner field: emit-span.cjs / trace-context.cjs lineage_root_session_id (env MYTHOS_LINEAGE_ROOT_SESSION_ID), named lineage_root at the enforcement layer.

action.description: The action the enforcement home saw and ruled on. Concept (Tool Broker): it 'maps a model's proposed action', validates 'scope + execution mode + permission stage', and 'denies/escalates unsafe actions'. Sub-fields {proposed, classified_layer, verdict}. Session close/sweep maps here as a read-only lifecycle action.

proposed.description: The proposed action, home-neutral (e.g. tool name + summary, or 'session-close: <reason>'). Concept: adapter 'can propose an action; it can never perform one.'

classified_layer.description: The permission/hardening layer the action was classified into. Concept 4-phase Permission Staging + hardening gradient.

verdict.description: The enforcement home's ruling. Concept: 'denies/escalates unsafe actions'; allow = permitted. Grounded in the Claude hook permissionDecision (allow/deny/ask).

evidence.description: Artifact refs recorded with the span. Concept (Tool Broker): 'It records artifacts + spans'. Grounded in emit-span.cjs frameworks_referenced/frameworks_adopted array convention. Array of path/URI strings.

enforcement_home.description: Which home emitted this span. Concept adjustment #5: Claude action -> claude-hook; brokered/external action -> tool-broker; the fork's native code -> native. This is the field that PROVES convergence: identical shape, different home value.

timestamps.description: Timestamps as PASSED IN by the emitting home, never generated inside the span builder (passive-sensor invariant carried from emit-span.cjs).

started_at.description: ISO-8601 action start, supplied by the caller.

ended_at.description: ISO-8601 action end, supplied by the caller. null while in flight.

status.description: Terminal status of the action. 'tombstone' carries the concept's requirement that a crashed/TTL-expired sub-mind in EITHER home 'must write a consistent lineage-carrying tombstone' (no silent loss; registry-as-coroner).
